items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: We knew, uh, Mr. Dudley, S.H. Dudley

ctx.x: I wondered. Well, now, uh, uh, we, uh, uh, in 1914, that's the first time we supposed to come up north,

you know. We went to Memphis, Tennessee. Wasn't it, Matt? Yeah. No, we went to Memphis in 1911. 1911. But it was 1914 when we'd come back to New Orleans and organized this company. And then went to New York. Yes. And went everywhere along the lines, stopping in different towns. And at that time, we didn't have any booking agents. We'd just write to the theater managers that we could hear of. Book yourself directly. Just book direct all the way along from New Orleans to New York. Later, there was that T.O.B.A.…
Johnny Dodds and- Well, that's what I wanted to hear about. Mud Carey told me he came up to Chicago with you.
